description: Recommended moderation case fields supporting unmatched rules/categories.

required_review_fields.admin_selected_category: Category ID selected by reviewing admin.
required_review_fields.matched_rule_id: Rule ID or null if none adequately fits.
required_review_fields.rules_gap: True when current written rules do not adequately cover the incident.

example_unmatched_case.reason_existing_rules_do_not_fit: The conduct is clearly disruptive but is not adequately described by the current rules.
